claims: 511 services provide real-time, 24/7 road conditions via websites, mobile apps, or by dialing 511.
511 services provide real-time, 24/7 traffic incidents via websites, mobile apps, or by dialing 511.
511 services provide real-time, 24/7 construction updates via websites, mobile apps, or by dialing 511.
511 services provide real-time, 24/7 weather-related closures via websites, mobile apps, or by dialing 511.
511 services generally cover interstates and state highways.
511 services can be accessed by dialing 511 from most phones.
